cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Orders from the Shadows
cards.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll supervise rebuilding those wedding bookings. You may start reassuring the couples.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cancellation log has your initials. Should I tell them that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. You're authorized to give replacement dates. I'll handle the log.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Bulk restore emails them the canceller's name. I can enter the dates again by hand, but it takes all afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I approve the afternoon. Keep them on the phone while I read you each date. They can hear how hard we're working to fix this.

reason: Make B explicitly establish the bulk-versus-reentry choice; A chooses conspicuous helpful work to avoid an incriminating automatic restoration.
